$comment: Shared behaviour contract for append-mode hosts writing. Consumed by src-tauri/src/hosts_apply/write.rs (make_append_content) and by test/e2e-mock/hosts-append-parity.test.ts (the Playwright Tauri mock). Both must satisfy every case; update this file when the behaviour intentionally changes. Each case applies `applies` in order, starting from `previous`, and compares the final file against `expected`.

cases.name: first_write_appends_marked_section
cases.why: A file that has never been managed gains the section at its end.

cases.name: first_write_into_empty_file_has_no_leading_blank_lines
cases.why: An empty head must not produce leading blank lines.

cases.name: legacy_section_without_end_is_replaced_to_eof_and_gains_end_marker
cases.why: Pre-END files: START owns everything to EOF, and END is added on rewrite.

cases.name: content_after_end_marker_is_preserved
cases.why: The whole point: records another tool appended below END survive.
cases.previous:
127.0.0.1 localhost
255.255.255.255 broadcasthost

# --- SWITCHHOSTS_CONTENT_START ---

1.2.3.4 old.com

# --- SWITCHHOSTS_CONTENT_END ---

# Added by Docker Desktop
192.168.65.2 host.docker.internal
cases.expected:
127.0.0.1 localhost
255.255.255.255 broadcasthost

# --- SWITCHHOSTS_CONTENT_START ---

5.6.7.8 new.com

# --- SWITCHHOSTS_CONTENT_END ---

# Added by Docker Desktop
192.168.65.2 host.docker.internal

cases.name: empty_content_keeps_empty_anchor_before_tail
cases.why: With a tail present the section keeps its slot, so it cannot drift below the tail.

cases.name: empty_content_without_section_keeps_head_only
cases.why: No tail to protect: leave no stray markers behind.

cases.name: stray_end_marker_before_start_stays_in_head
cases.why: END is only meaningful after START; an earlier one belongs to the head.

cases.name: marker_lines_inside_new_content_are_stripped
cases.why: A whole marker line in the payload would end the section early on the next parse.

cases.name: inline_marker_reference_in_content_is_kept
cases.why: A valid hosts record that merely quotes a marker must not be deleted.

cases.name: inline_marker_reference_is_not_a_section_boundary
cases.why: The tail starts after the real END line, not after an inline mention.
